title: Korean-Style Braised Naengmyeon with Cabbage
description: A French-inspired twist on the Korean dish, featuring tender naengmyeon noodles and a rich, savory sauce made with Korean chili flakes and tender cabbage.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the ginger and garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar to the pan. Whisk until smooth.
Add the cabbage to the pan and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the naengmyeon noodles to the pan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are well coated in the sauce.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with green onions and toasted sesame seeds if desired.
